Hi @alxhub,

I have created new branch (i have changed guide in previous comment) it contains only app component and component with problem and i have also found out, that is caused by `NgSelectModule` (its @anglr/select), but interesting thing is that this was working in all versions until `14.0.2`, so there were some changes that caused this.

Thanks for any help.

This is introduced by #46096, which fixed a bug that could result in compiler crashes for certain pipes. However, there is a pre-existing bug in which pipes are considered in this check; the compiler incorrectly looks at _all_ pipes in the compilation scope of the NgModule, whereas it should only consider the _used pipes_ in the template.

…uirement

After a bugfix in #46096, the compiler is now better capable of detecting pipes
which require an inline type constructor. However, there is an issue in how all
pipes are considered when verifying the inline type-ctor requirement: it should
only check actually used pipes.

Fixes #46747
